integrity: Proves five analytic generators via formal lifting and a sixth initial coefficient generated by cancellation; source results on normality, defect and lower bound are credited. No independent priority or audit certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact embedding dimension for this specified genus-two nonlinear family only; no generalization to higher genus, negative defect, all local analytic equations, or every neighborhood. Residual risk of implicit historic coverage in Grauert 1962 remains.
title: Sharp embedding dimension five for genus-two nonlinear surface contractions
